sectionHeading:
One Engine.
Four ways to put it to work.
sectionSupportCopy: Alter Engine is the foundation. Use it directly, apply it to inventory operations, shape it around an enterprise process or bring it into an existing product.

engine.title: Alter Engine
engine.description: Turn one objective into a clear sequence of work. Review the plan, approve important actions and inspect the result.
engine.detailTitle: From one objective to reviewable work.
engine.detailExplanation: Alter Engine identifies what needs to be completed, proposes the steps and keeps approval points clear before actions run.

detailRows.label: What you provide
detailRows.text: The result you need and the relevant context.

detailRows.label: What the Engine does
detailRows.text: Structures the work and carries out approved steps.

detailRows.label: What you receive
detailRows.text: A result with its decisions, actions and checks available for review.

cognitive.title: Cognitive AI
cognitive.description: Bring stock attention, forecasting signals, product decisions and supplier actions into one operating view.
cognitive.detailTitle: Every inventory decision, explained and routed.
cognitive.detailExplanation: Instead of searching dashboards, Cognitive AI surfaces what needs your attention, explains why, and routes the necessary supplier actions for approval.

detailRows.label: What you provide
detailRows.text: Your forecast data and current inventory states.

detailRows.label: What the Engine does
detailRows.text: Identifies signals, explains the cause, and drafts the next action.

detailRows.label: What you receive
detailRows.text: Clear decisions ready for human approval.

custom.title: Custom workflows
custom.description: Design an Alter Engine workflow around your existing systems, permissions, handoffs and operating rules.
custom.detailExplanation: Bring the capability of Alter Engine into your unique operating environment without compromising your existing permissions or security.

detailRows.label: What you provide
detailRows.text: Your operating rules and authorized systems.

detailRows.label: What the Engine does
detailRows.text: Translates objectives into your specific workflow steps.

detailRows.label: What you receive
detailRows.text: Engine automation that respects your governance.

build.title: Build with AlterX
build.description: Bring planned, approval-aware Alter Engine workflows into a product or internal environment.
build.detailExplanation: Provide your users with reliable, step-by-step automation that pauses for their approval and returns a fully transparent execution record.

detailRows.label: What you provide
detailRows.text: An API connection and user objectives.

detailRows.label: What the Engine does
detailRows.text: Plans the work and streams execution states back.

detailRows.label: What you receive
detailRows.text: A deterministic, reviewable result for your users.
